prompt: Extreme Hollywood pyro title sequence: begin inside a microscopic droplet of fuel suspended in darkness as a spark suddenly ignites its surface. Fire spreads explosively outward and the camera rockets backward through a chain reaction of enormous fuel explosions. Liquid fire whips across the frame like glowing ribbons while burning debris and sparks spiral into a rapidly expanding fire tornado. The camera enters the vortex and rotates around a white-hot molten core where streams of liquid metal begin violently forging the gigantic word "BURN". Every letter emerges incandescent from the inferno before cooling into cracked black steel while magma remains visible beneath the surface. The completed title slams into frame with enormous weight as flames blast through the gaps between the letters. Pressure suddenly builds inside the typography until "BURN" violently ruptures from within, unleashing a radial explosion of molten metal, sparks and fire directly into the lens. Extreme heat distortion, realistic pyro physics, aggressive camera movement, AAA theatrical VFX.
